alerts.headline: Flood Warning issued June 21 at 2:23PM CDT until June 25 at 4:00PM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
alerts.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Navasota River near Normangee affecting Brazos, Madison and
Grimes Counties.

For the Navasota River...including Normangee...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Navasota River near Normangee.

* WHEN...From Monday morning to Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 18.0 feet, Moderate lowland flooding begins as three
channels merge into one below State Highway 21. There is
widespread inundation of the floodplain in the vicinity of the
gage with the river more than 1.5 miles wide. Long Trussel Road in
northeast Brazos County below State Highway 21 becomes inundated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:00 PM CDT Sunday the stage was 10.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
tomorrow morning to a crest of 19.4 feet tomorrow evening. It
will then fall below flood stage early Thursday morning.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of
19.3 feet on 12/19/2001.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
alerts.areaDesc: Brazos, TX; Grimes, TX; Madison, TX
